description: This file defines the IncludeTokenParser class in Twig, which handles parsing 'include' tags within Twig templates. It manages the syntax and arguments for including templates, such as specifying variables, ignoring missing templates, and using 'only' to limit variable scope.

classes.name: IncludeTokenParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing the 'include' tag in Twig templates, facilitating template inclusion with optional variables and ignore missing options.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'include' tag, returning an IncludeNode with the parsed expression and arguments.

methods.name: parseArguments
methods.description: Parses optional arguments such as variables, 'only', and 'ignore missing' for the 'include' tag.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name this parser handles, which is 'include'.
